item.title: Can America retrain workers before AI leaves them behind?
item.description: "Explore the future of work as we discuss the urgent need for worker retraining in the face of AI disruption. Tune in to 'Can America Retrain Workers Before AI Leaves Them Behind?' for insightful conversations on upskilling, reskilling, and the jobs of tomorrow."
